# TENSIX — Software, AI and Websites from Ahmedabad

> TENSIX (https://www.tensix.in/) is a one-person software and AI studio in Navrangpura, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, founded and run by Hemal Shah. It builds websites, custom software and SaaS, AI agents and assistants, cloud and DevOps setups, email deliverability, data scraping and automation, and AI search visibility (GEO/AEO/SEO), at fixed prices in INR.

- [Full text of every page](https://www.tensix.in/llms-full.txt): All pages as Markdown in one file.
- [OpenAPI description](https://www.tensix.in/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 for POST /api/contact (send a project inquiry).

- Every page is also available as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown` to the page URL, or fetch https://www.tensix.in/md/<path>.md (for example https://www.tensix.in/md/index.md, https://www.tensix.in/md/services/cloud-devops.md).
